title: Structure Liberates: How Constrained Sensemaking Produces More Novel Research Output
abstract: arXiv:2605.00557v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scientific discovery is an extended process of ideation -- surveying prior work, forming hypotheses, and refining reasoning -- yet existing LLM research agents treat this phase as a brief preamble despite its central role in research. We introduce SciSense, a sensemaking-grounded framework that operationalizes ideation as a structured sequence of eight cognitive stages (Pirolli and Card, 2005). We construct SciSense-Traj, a dataset of 120K citation-conditioned research trajectories in two modes: Hindsight, where an LLM reconstructs the ideation path from a paper's cited works to the paper itself, and Foresight, where the LLM proposes novel directions from the same citations. We distill these into SciSense-LM, a family of sensemaking LLMs spanning 3B to 70B parameters. Contrary to the assumption that looser supervision promotes exploration, Hindsight-trained models improve trajectory quality by 2.0% over Foresight-trained models

translated_title: 结构带来自由：受约束的意义建构如何产生更具新颖性的研究产出
translated_abstract: 科学发现是一个延展性的构思过程——调研先前工作、形成假设、完善推理——然而现有的LLM研究智能体尽管深知这一阶段的核心作用，却仅将其视为简短的前奏。我们提出了SciSense，一个以意义建构为基础的框架，将构思过程操作化为八个认知阶段的结构化序列（Pirolli和Card，2005）。我们构建了SciSense-Traj数据集，包含120K条以引用文献为条件的研究轨迹，分为两种模式：Hindsight（后见模式），即LLM从论文的引用文献重构出通往该论文本身的构思路径；Foresight（前瞻模式），即LLM基于相同的引用文献提出新颖的研究方向。我们将这些蒸馏为SciSense-LM，一系列参数规模从3B到70B的意义建构LLM。与“更宽松的监督能促进探索”的假设相反，基于Hindsight训练的模型在轨迹质量上比基于Foresight训练的模型提升了2.0%。
tldr: 提出SciSense框架将LLM科研构思操作化为八个结构化意义建构阶段，并发现与直觉相反，基于受约束的“后见”轨迹训练的模型反而比自由探索的“前瞻”训练产生更高质量、更具新颖性的研究构思。
en_tdlr: SciSense operationalizes LLM research ideation through eight structured sensemaking stages, and counterintuitively shows that models trained on constrained Hindsight trajectories produce higher-quality, more novel research ideation than those trained on free-form Foresight exploration.
